name: spell-forge-contracts-toolchain
description: Isolated TS toolchain that drives scrypt-cli to compile src/bsv/contracts/*.ts to sCrypt artifacts. Kept out of the app's own package.json: scrypt-ts-transpiler (pulled in by scrypt-cli) needs TypeScript ~5.3 via ts-patch, which cannot patch the app's TypeScript 5.9.3. See src/bsv/contracts/toolchain/README.md.
